answer.main_body: stalagmite with flat rock ledge and spike
answer.evidence: The stalagmite features a broad flat ledge spanning rows 7-12 (with an embedded drip pool) clearly seen from above, as well as a flattened wet top on the spike at rows 2-3.

The object clearly displays top surfaces in 3/4 view: the stalagmite spike has a flat top surface at rows 2-3 with a highlight, and the broad adjoining rock ledge displays its top surface across rows 7-12 containing a blue drip pool.

answer.main_body: stalagmite rock formation with side ledge
answer.evidence: The stalagmite features a flat wet top surface on the central column (rows 1-3) and an expansive horizontal ledge surface with a blue drip pool on the right flank (rows 7-12) viewed from an overhead 3/4 perspective.

The stalagmite features a clearly visible foreshortened top surface on both the spike tip (rows 2-3) and the broad ledge on the right (rows 8-13, containing a blue drip pool) above the front drop-off face (rows 14-15).
